## F38 implementation verified

F38 replaced the dated maintenance audit snapshot with a project adapter to the packaged janitor workflow. The adapter requires an audit ticket and related session log, documents the absolute module-size gate and shrink-only complexity gate, cites ADR 0058 and the relevant historical tickets, and removes dated measurements and captured tool markup.

Only `docs/maintenance-audit-runbook.md` changed. All D1 through D5 checks passed, the documented inspection commands passed, `make lint` passed, and `make typecheck` passed. The full suite was skipped under the documentation-only rule. Commit and Gerrit review remain pending.
